content: lipgloss v2 removed the Renderer type and SetColorProfile. Color downsampling in v2 happens at print time, not in Style.Render(). Use lipgloss.NewWriter(os.Stdout) for a one-shot CLI. COLORTERM=truecolor, TERM=xterm-256color, NO_COLOR, and WT_SESSION (Windows Terminal) are the key env vars for profile detection. When stdout is not a TTY, lipgloss strips ANSI automatically.
